item.title: Japan: 1,800 people pull 360-tonne Hirosaki Castle keep by hand
item.description: About 1,800 people came together in northern Japan to pull a 360-tonne castle keep by hand. The Hirosaki Castle keep was moved in 2015 so its earthquake-damaged stone wall could undergo repairs. Now, using hikiya, a technique that places buildings on rollers so they can be moved without dismantling them, the keep is being brought closer to its original position. Those taking part were selected through a lottery system. Moving efforts will continue until the end of August. Fuente: France 24 - English.

item.title: CIA director John Ratcliffe reportedly on Moscow visit
item.description: Unannounced trip reported by US media is said to be Ratcliffe’s first known visit to Russia as CIA chief The CIA director, John Ratcliffe, has made an unannounced visit to Moscow, US media reported, after flight data showed an American military aircraft flew to the Russian capital, where a US diplomatic motorcade was later spotted. CBS News quoted sources familiar with the situation as confirming Ratcliffe’s trip, saying it was his first known visit to Russia as CIA chief. Axios separately confirmed the visit, quoting a US official. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Expert pieces together puzzle from fragments of 1,600-year-old Roman text
item.description: A Roman law expert at the University of Cincinnati edited and translated a Latin legal text he pieced together from fragments that surprisingly survived in the Egyptian sands for more than 1,600 years. What's less surprising? It's about taxes. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: London bus drivers resume strike over heatwave working amid fears over air con deal
item.description: Drivers concerned that bus operator’s offer to retrofit cabs on 730 buses will not be complete by next summer London bus drivers have resumed strike action over having to work in high temperatures, amid fears that proposed improvements to air conditioning will not be complete by next summer. About 1,500 members of the Unite union working across north London and Essex are taking part in the four-day strike from Tuesday to Friday, after industrial action earlier this month. Further stoppages are planned for the coming weeks. Continue reading... Publicado también por: The Guardian - Environment. Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: España ha desplegado 1.219 agentes de Policía en 14 aeropuertos para controlar a 8.216 viajeros de terceros países que han lleggado desde Italia en apenas 2 semanas. item.title: 7,000-year-old beaver bone pit reveals how Europe’s first farmers used animal fur
item.description: Near Alsleben, Germany, archaeologists have unearthed a beaver bone pit that dates back 7,000 years. This remarkable find sheds light on the early farming communities and their sophisticated practices in fur exploitation. The arrangement of the bones points to organized hunting activities. Researchers suggest that such evidence indicates that these ancient peoples crafted intricate fur clothing to adapt to their environment. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: SCALP, el misil de largo alcance que el Reino Unido ayudará a fabricar en Ucrania

Se trata de un misil de crucero lanzado desde aeronaves y diseñado para atacar objetivos terrestres de alto valor situados a larga distancia.
